request:
Suicide-YF consists of Mandarin Chinese speech recordings from 1,223 adolescents aged 10--18 years recruited in Guangdong, China. 
The participants were asked to complete an online survey, in which they were asked whether they had ever experienced suicidal thoughts or behaviours. Those who answered yes were invited to participate in the study. Additionally, a control group of children with no suicide risk was selected for comparison with the at-risk participants. 不需要文本匿名，跑所有方法总结处理该类任务的经验
